messages:
maria: FYI customer ACME opened an escalation — they saw a huge billing spike yesterday tied to streaming endpoints. They claim many requests ended with client disconnects but were counted as 5xx -> billed. They attached sample request IDs: req_8f3a, req_8f4b, req_8f77. Can SRE investigate? :warning:

jack-sre: Thanks — can you paste a minimal repro and one of the raw gateway logs? Also which model/route and region?

maria: Route is /v1/stream/chat (us-west). Customer says they use chunked uploads for a long-lived request and then client aborts during stream. They sent this curl repro:```bash
curl -v -N \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" \n  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \n  --data-binary $'3\r\nhey\r\n0\r\n' \n  https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream/chat
```
They attached gateway log snippet:```
[2026-03-10T20:34:12Z] upstream read error: unexpected EOF while reading response body, connection reset by peer, req=req_8f3a
[2026-03-10T20:34:12Z] classify: upstream closed socket -> counted as 5xx
```

jack-sre: Looks like the gateway is mapping upstream socket resets to 5xx without distinguishing client-initiated FIN/FIN+RST vs server error. If client does half-close after receiving some events, our classifier may see it as an abrupt upstream teardown. We need to check connection close reason in the proxy (nginx/nginx-proxy / envoy) and whether read error came from peer abort vs upstream application error.

ingrid-platform: I dug through ingress traces — at 20:34:11 there's a lot of long-polling streaming connections with low traffic. The connection graph shows client -> gateway sent RST shortly after gateway forwarded final chunk; gateway then marked as 502 in metrics pipeline. Interesting: the request reached the model shard and produced tokens, but gateway marked it as upstream error because the socket closed before trailer/EOF.

jack-sre: Can you grab the tcp_close_reason and proxy logs for req_8f3a/req_8f4b? If the client sent FIN then we should treat as client_abort (499) not a server 5xx. Our billing pipeline currently treats anything with upstream socket reset as 5xx; that's the problem.

maria: Attached tcp_close_reason:```
req_8f3a: CLOSE_REASON_RST_BY_CLIENT
req_8f4b: CLOSE_REASON_FIN_BY_CLIENT
```
Customer provided app logs showing they explicitly cancel the request when user closes the UI. They argue it should be considered a client abort and not billed as a 5xx.

alex-billing: From billing side — invoices are generated from the 5xx-tagged metering stream. If these are reclassified we can issue credits. Need a list of affected request ids + invoice ids and timeframe.

jack-sre: Proposed short-term mitigations: 1) exclude streaming connections with tcp_close_reason FIN or RST_BY_CLIENT from 5xx billing aggregation (safe) 2) add a selector that verifies whether the model returned any tokens before labeling as 5xx (if tokens emitted -> likely client disconnect). Both quick fixes but we should validate for abuse vectors.

deploy-bot: New deploy: envoy/proxy heuristics v2.14.3 rolled at 2026-03-10T22:40:00Z to us-west (change: close_reason passthrough).

ingrid-platform: I can push change to metering rule to ignore close_reason=FIN_BY_CLIENT/RST_BY_CLIENT for 24h and monitor for discrepancies. Will also add a spike alert if unbilled ETA > 1% of normal.

alex-billing: Please surface list of invoice lines affected so I can prepare a one-off credit and a note to ACME.

jack-sre: For long-term: we should update gateway classifier to set response code to 499 for client aborts and ensure meter uses actual response code + token count. Also update docs so customers know transient disconnects aren't billed if they were client-initiated.

maria: Customer is asking for an immediate temporary credit while you roll the heuristic. I'll collect the req ids and invoice ids and DM billing.

jack-sre: Action items:
- ingrid-platform: change metering rule to exclude client close reasons (short-term) — OWNER (ETA 1h)
- jack-sre: patch gateway classifier to emit 499 for client aborts and add unit tests (OWNER, ETA 2d)
- alex-billing: prepare draft credit for ACME once we have invoice lines (OWNER, ETA 3h)
- maria: coordinate with customer and confirm repro + collect additional request ids (OWNER, ETA 30m)

maria: Thanks — ping me when ingrid flips the rule and jack opens the PR. :thumbsup:
